items.title: Jack Lesberg interviewed by Monk Rowe, Aspen, Colorado, October 11, 1997
items.q: I spend some time, I like to practice, with a couple of guys around New York, John Bunch being one of them... we play.

ctx.x: What’s in the immediate future for you?

Well I just hope I can keep playing. I love to play. And as I say I very fortunately still have some contacts and get over to Europe a bit and occasionally for a tour. I’ve been over with Ralph, he’s quite busy in that area and we’re old buddies and I work with him quite often. I just hope to keep moving. I spend some time, I like to practice, with a couple of guys around New York, John Bunch being one of them who lives nearby and he has a big Steinway in his living room and he’s got a bass that I strung up, it’s…
Well I’m glad you haven’t lost that passion. That’s great.
